integrity: The proof gives a nonexperimental infinite argument. Two standalone programs separately verify finite instances through 8 and 12 and are included with their full source.
scientific_limitations: The theorem supplies exact distance for one explicit pair at every n≥2, not the global diameter or all-pairs spectrum. Literature priority is qualified and independent audit has not occurred.
title: Quadratic detours under adjacent swaps of 231-avoiding permutations
